_about: The one pinned table of the runtime layer's way 'fetch' (orchestrator/Core/runtime_layer.py PREBUILT): per tool and architecture the URL and the sha256 of every prebuilt static program it may fetch. kind 'deb': a Debian package (archive_sha256 of the package, member and sha256 of the program in it); kind 'file': the program itself (sha256). busybox comes from Debian's busybox-static on snapshot.debian.org. setpriv comes only as the framework's own Rust program llmcf-setpriv, a release asset of this project built by its CI (.github/workflows/release-tools.yml on a tag tools-v<version>): kind 'file', name 'llmcf-setpriv-<version>-<x86_64|aarch64>' under the key amd64 or arm64, url '.../releases/download/tools-v<version>/<name>' of this project, sha256 from the release's SHA256SUMS. util-linux setpriv is C and is never fetched; any other setpriv entry is left out. Until the maintainer publishes such a release and enters it here, setpriv has no entry (no release yet) and the way 'fetch' refuses, naming the ways that build here.
